title: Recover without damaging live or validation state
when: Rehearsal, fleet copy or boot refuses
need: Follow named authority/identity/restore-point/ledger/fleet failures. Busy fleet copy is a wait with holder details; failed proof earns no receipt. Applied history is immutable, and item receipt cannot substitute for release fleet proof.
gap: A human troubleshooting front door should route failures by missing authority, missing declaration and failed proof; do not hide all behind generic database setup.
